name: Vintage Faire Mall
summary: Vintage Faire Mall is Modesto's premier enclosed regional shopping center featuring department stores, national retail chains, and entertainment options including Dave & Buster's. The spacious mall offers a complete shopping experience with a food court, indoor play area, and regular community events.
demographics: Vintage Faire Mall attracts a diverse, middle-income demographic primarily from Modesto and the surrounding Central Valley communities. The trade area serves families with children, young adults, and seniors seeking a comprehensive shopping experience with both value and variety. Typical visitors include households with median incomes ranging from $50,000 to $85,000, drawn to the mix of department stores, national chains, and dining options. The mall serves as a regional destination for Stanislaus County residents who appreciate the convenience of an enclosed shopping environment with entertainment amenities like Dave & Buster's and a food court.
description: Vintage Faire Mall stands as Modesto's premier enclosed shopping destination, serving the Central Valley community since its opening. This spacious regional mall features a comprehensive mix of department store anchors and familiar retail chains that cater to the diverse needs of local families and shoppers. Beyond traditional retail, the center has evolved into an entertainment hub with attractions like Dave & Buster's, an indoor play area for children, and a vibrant food court offering diverse dining options. The mall's commitment to community engagement is evident through its regular events programming and happy hour offerings that bring together residents for social experiences. With convenient hours from 10 AM to 9 PM daily and ample amenities, Vintage Faire Mall continues to be the go-to shopping and entertainment destination for Modesto and surrounding Stanislaus County communities.
